name: 12-hydroxy-LSD
summary: 12-Hydroxy-LSD, also known as 12-hydroxylysergic acid diethylamide, is a drug of the ergoline and lysergamide families and a derivative of lysergic acid diethylamide (LSD). In terms of chemical structure, 12-hydroxy-LSD is to LSD as bufotenin (5-HO-DMT) is to dimethyltryptamine (DMT), with 12-hydroxy-LSD notably containing bufotenin within its conformationally constrained structure.

pharmacology.text: 12-Hydroxy-LSD is known to be pharmacologically active in animal studies. The drug's effects in rabbits include antiserotonergic activity (25% of that of LSD) and hyperthermia (dose ratio relative to LD50 of 1:44 for 12-hydroxy-LSD and 1:725 for LSD).

uses.en: It is used only in research.

sideEffects.en: Its effects in people are not known. In rabbits it raised body temperature.
sideEffects.zh: 它對人體的作用未知。在兔子身上，它會使體溫升高。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它对人体的作用未知。在兔子身上，它会使体温升高。

fact.en: Its structure holds the whole shape of bufotenin locked in place, much as LSD holds the shape of DMT.
fact.zh: 它的結構中完整鎖住了蟾蜍色胺（bufotenin）的形狀，就像LSD中包含了DMT的形狀一樣。
fact.zhHans: 它的结构中完整锁住了蟾蜍色胺（bufotenin）的形状，就像LSD中包含了DMT的形状一样。
